subject: What remains — the self that does not die
place: The inner self, beyond the body
events: The body grows old and falls away
The self does not die, for it was never born
What remains is the self — the realization from within
grounding_notes: The self is not the body, not the name, not the story.
The self is the one who watches, who knows, who is.
The self does not die because it was never born.
The answer to Who am I? needs no words.
